flags.summary: Walmart runs ~4,000 in-store pharmacies and for years self-distributed controlled substances to them. Over its opioid dispensing and suspicious-order reporting it faced a 2020 U.S. DOJ civil suit and joined the 2022 national opioid settlement, accruing ~$3.3B (since paid in full). Settled without admitting wrongdoing.
flags.quote: the Company accrued a liability of approximately $3.3 billion in fiscal year 2023 for certain opioid-related settlements. As of January 31, 2025, all of the accrued liability has been paid.

flags.summary: CVS operates one of the largest U.S. pharmacy chains. Over opioid dispensing it reached a ~$5B national settlement in 2022 and continues to record opioid-litigation charges (a $320M charge in 2025). Settled without admitting wrongdoing.
flags.quote: a $320 million opioid litigation charge related to a change in the Company’s accrual for ongoing opioid litigation matters

flags.summary: Johnson & Johnson manufactured prescription opioids (Duragesic, Nucynta). Named in ~3,500 suits over opioid marketing, it agreed to a national settlement and has accrued ~$1.1B to resolve remaining opioid litigation.
flags.quote: have been named in close to 3,500 lawsuits related to the marketing of opioids, including DURAGESIC, NUCYNTA and NUCYNTA ER

flags.summary: AbbVie's Allergan unit manufactured and sold prescription opioids. It faced ~335 suits in the national opioid litigation (MDL 2804) and took part in the manufacturers' settlement.
flags.quote: Lawsuits are pending against Allergan and several other manufacturers generally alleging that they improperly promoted and sold prescription opioid products.

flags.summary: Berkshire owns Berkshire Hathaway Energy, whose utilities operate ~20,900 miles of interstate natural-gas pipelines and generate power from gas — a material fossil-fuel business most people don't associate with Berkshire.
flags.quote: five U.S. interstate natural gas pipeline companies with approximately 20,900 miles of operated pipeline having a design capacity of approximately 21.6 billion cubic feet of natural gas per day

flags.summary: Berkshire Hathaway Energy's regulated utilities still operate coal-fueled power plants, with some units slated to run past 2038 under emission limits.
flags.quote: Coal-fueled units that will operate after December 31, 2038, must meet emission limits equivalent to operating with carbon capture and sequestration beginning January 1, 2032

flags.summary: GE Aerospace is a defense contractor: it develops and produces military jet engines and propulsion systems, and describes its role as a defense contractor in its filings.
flags.quote: related to our role as a defense contractor

flags.summary: NextEra, known for renewables, also generates power from natural gas and holds large firm natural-gas pipeline capacity (~2.8M MMBtu/day) to supply its fossil-fuel generation.
flags.quote: firm transportation contracts with ten different transportation suppliers for natural gas pipeline capacity for an aggregate maximum delivery quantity of 2,836,000 MMBtu/day

flags.summary: Southern Company's gas utilities operate ~77,900 miles of natural-gas pipelines and distribution, and it generates power from gas — a large fossil-fuel business alongside its regulated electric utilities.
flags.quote: operates, constructs, and maintains approximately 77,900 miles of natural gas pipelines

flags.summary: Southern Company's electric utilities (Alabama Power, Georgia Power, Mississippi Power) still operate coal-fired generating capacity, some of it slated to retire or convert to gas.
flags.quote: plans to retire or convert to natural gas certain coal-fired generating capacity

flags.summary: Duke Energy generates power from natural gas and holds interstate gas-pipeline interests (e.g. a 7.5% stake in the Sabal Trail pipeline) — a material fossil-fuel business within its utilities.
flags.quote: Sabal Trail Natural Gas Pipeline, which is regulated by FERC and traverses Alabama, Georgia, and Florida to transport natural gas to Florida

flags.summary: Duke Energy operates coal-fired power generation across its utility fleet, managing coal inventory for dispatch.
flags.quote: Coal inventory levels may fluctuate as a result of volatility in natural gas prices and the associated impacts on coal-fired dispatch within the generation fleet

flags.summary: Dominion Energy operates coal-fired power generation; it produces and stores coal ash (CCRs) as a by-product across 11 facilities.
flags.quote: continue to produce coal ash, or CCRs, as a by-product of their coal-fired generation operations

flags.summary: Constellation Energy, though mostly nuclear, owns ~21 GW of natural-gas-fired generation (via Calpine) — combined-cycle gas plants in Texas, California and the Northeast.
flags.quote: Calpine owns 21 GWs of natural gas-fired generation, primarily consisting of combined cycle gas turbine plants in the Texas, California, and Northeast regions of the United States.

flags.summary: American Electric Power owns ~10,700 MW of coal-fired generating capacity (of ~25,400 MW total), including the Mitchell, Rockport and Turk plants.
flags.quote: AEP owned generating capacity of approximately 25,400 MWs, of which approximately 10,700 MWs were coal-fired

flags.summary: Royal Caribbean operates casinos on its cruise ships as a core part of its onboard revenue.
flags.quote: revenues from the sale of goods and/or services onboard our ships not included in passenger ticket prices, casino operations

flags.summary: Monster Beverage, best known for energy drinks, also develops, markets and distributes craft beers, flavored malt beverages, and hard seltzers (its 'Beast' alcohol line).
flags.quote: We also develop, market, sell and distribute craft beers, flavored malt beverages ("FMBs") and hard seltzers

flags.summary: Robinhood offers sports-related event/prediction contracts that regulators (e.g. New Jersey's DGE) have called unlicensed sports wagering, drawing cease-and-desist demands.
flags.quote: cease and desist from offering sports-related event contracts, which the NJDGE views as unlicensed sports wagering
